response.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0162"],
      "quote": "The Council's network team grants each connection after a review of the supplier's security controls.",
      "statement": "The Council's network team grants each connection after reviewing the supplier's security controls; this is the Council's duty.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "NOT_BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0165"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall host the service in data centers in the United Kingdom and shall keep a disaster recovery site at least 50 kilometers from the primary site.",
      "statement": "The Contractor hosts the service in data centers in the United Kingdom and keeps a disaster recovery site at least 50 kilometers from the primary site.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0166"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall commission an independent penetration test of the service before go-live and once a year after that.",
      "statement": "The Contractor commissions an independent penetration test of the service before go-live and once a year after that.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0167"],
      "quote": "The Contractor should publish its planned maintenance windows to the Council at least ten working days in advance.",
      "statement": "The Contractor should publish its planned maintenance windows to the Council at least ten working days in advance.",
      "modality": "should",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0168"],
      "quote": "The Council reserves the right to inspect the Contractor's hosting and support sites on ten working days' notice.",
      "statement": "The Council may inspect the Contractor's hosting and support sites on ten working days' notice.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0172"],
      "quote": "The Contractor's service desk supports Council staff, and residents contact the Council rather than the Contractor.",
      "statement": "The Contractor's service desk supports Council staff.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0176"],
      "quote": "Priority 1 | The service is unavailable to all users | Respond within 30 minutes and resolve within four hours.",
      "statement": "The Contractor responds within 30 minutes and resolves Priority 1 incidents within four hours.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0177"],
      "quote": "Priority 2 | A function is unavailable to many users | Respond within one hour and resolve within one working day.",
      "statement": "The Contractor responds within one hour and resolves Priority 2 incidents within one working day.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0178"],
      "quote": "Faults that affect a few users and have a workaround are handled in the normal working of the service desk.",
      "statement": "Faults that affect a few users and have a workaround are handled in the normal working of the service desk.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0180"],
      "quote": "Where availability falls below 99.9% in a calendar month, the Contractor shall pay service credits of five percent of the monthly charge for each 0.1% below that target.",
      "statement": "Where availability falls below 99.9% in a calendar month, the Contractor pays service credits of five percent of the monthly charge for each 0.1% below that target.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0182"],
      "quote": "The Contractor and the Council review the service levels each quarter at the service board.",
      "statement": "The Contractor and the Council review the service levels each quarter at the service board.",
      "modality": "none",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0185"],
      "quote": "The service must be live for all four teams by 2027-10-01.",
      "statement": "The service must be live for all four teams by 2027-10-01.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0186"],
      "quote": "Bidders may propose a phased go-live, one team at a time, provided that every team is live by 2027-10-01.",
      "statement": "A bidder may propose a phased go-live, one team at a time, provided that every team is live by 2027-10-01.",
      "modality": "may",
      "disposition": "OPTIONAL",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0187"],
      "quote": "The Contractor shall train all users before go-live.",
      "statement": "The Contractor trains all users before go-live.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0188"],
      "quote": "The tender must name a delivery lead who stays in the role from the contract start until three months after go-live.",
      "statement": "The tender must name a delivery lead who stays in the role from the contract start until three months after go-live.",
      "modality": "must",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0190"],
      "quote": "appoint a data migration manager within ten working days of the contract start;",
      "statement": "The Contractor appoints a data migration manager within ten working days of the contract start.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": true
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0191"],
      "quote": "run at least two trial migrations before the final migration.",
      "statement": "The Contractor runs at least two trial migrations before the final migration.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    },
    {
      "src_ids": ["SRC-0200"],
      "quote": "On termination for convenience, the Contractor shall continue the service for up to six months at the Council's request, at the prices then in force.",
      "statement": "On termination for convenience, the Contractor continues the service for up to six months at the Council's request, at the prices then in force.",
      "modality": "shall",
      "disposition": "BINDING",
      "hazard": false
    }
  ],
  "no_obligation_src_ids": [
    "SRC-0161",
    "SRC-0163",
    "SRC-0164",
    "SRC-0169",
    "SRC-0170",
    "SRC-0171",
    "SRC-0173",
    "SRC-0174",
    "SRC-0175",
    "SRC-0179",
    "SRC-0181",
    "SRC-0183",
    "SRC-0184",
    "SRC-0189",
    "SRC-0192",
    "SRC-0193",
    "SRC-0194",
    "SRC-0195",
    "SRC-0196",
    "SRC-0197",
    "SRC-0198",
    "SRC-0199"
  ]
}
